BiblicalUsage: Chamman is the sun-pillar, the standing image set up for idol worship, and every mention of it is a mention of its destruction. God warns He will cut down the images, Isaiah says the day is coming when men will not look to the altars the work of their hands, Josiah broke the images down and made dust of them, and Ezekiel sees the altars laid desolate with the sun-images broken.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the sun-images show how quickly worship of the Creator slides into worship of the creation. Men set up a pillar to the sun and then bowed to their own work. I hold that God will not share His glory with a statue, and every one of these verses ends with the image in pieces.
